title: Last names A to Z
statementMd:
List the last names of all employees in alphabetical order.

Expected columns: `last_name`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT last_name FROM employees ORDER BY last_name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
